split_unit: story triplet; 8 groups, not 24 independent samples

experiment_K.K0: flat screening rules with main articles
experiment_K.K1: scoped mechanism guide with dependency-aware reading

metrics.unjudged_policy: refuse complete metrics or report explicit missing; never impute zero
metrics.case_dedup: query-file; best reranked unit per document

acceptance.K: holdout three-state correct count nondecrease; >=1 fewer boundary error; no new normal/unknown error; no citation decline; budget unchanged
acceptance.R: development P5 and NDCG20 nondecrease; >=1 Top1 or >=.03 MRR gain; no new role error; otherwise stop

failure_policy: keep every frozen query; missing judgments are failures, missing relevance remains unjudged; max3 attempts for format only
semantic_review: blinded to ranks/arm/expected labels; model silver; no independent expert claim
